kir_chains.source: validation/structures/framed/*.pdb (54 framed KIR analysis units) and IPD-KIR 2.15.0
kir_chains.note: KIR chain sequences are the observed one-letter sequences of the framed chain K, read in coordinate order from real deposited structures — disordered loops and truncated constructs included, which is the point. Expected genes come from validation/loop_annotations.csv. tied_ectodomains are real IPD-KIR mature Ig extents that are byte-identical across genes.

non_kir_chains.source: /Users/drchristhorpe/Desktop/Claude Science/kirs/validation/structures/framed/*.pdb, every chain other than the framed KIR chain K
non_kir_chains.note: All 122 non-KIR chains across the 54 framed files -- the scope histo_kir_hmm/VERIFICATION_REPORT.md reports as 122/122 rejected. Only 60 of the sequences are distinct, because the same MHC heavy chain, b2m and peptide recur across entries; the duplicates are kept so the count matches the reference's.

non_kir_curated.note: Chains that actually co-occur with KIR in deposited structures, plus the LILR/LAIR and Ig-superfamily receptors that are the hardest negatives — LILRB1 is a 4-Ig-domain MHC class I-binding NK receptor in the same superfamily as KIR. All must be rejected.

_provenance.note: KIR chains and tied ectodomains copied verbatim from histo_kir_hmm/tests/fixtures/. The non-KIR chains are read from the same framed coordinates rather than from the 22-chain fixture, which is a curated subset plus UniProt receptors that appear in no structure.
